facts.text: The brothers' usual at Punch-Out. Red peppers one half and green the other.
facts.why: The half red, half green pepper order comes from the tie-in website SMBPlumbing.com, not the film. Super Mario Wiki says so on its Punch-Out Pizzeria page; the film shows Spike eating a slice while the brothers watch their ad, with no order.
facts.fix: Spike eats a slice and mocks the brothers. Red peppers one half and green the other.
facts.full: The brothers' usual at Punch-Out. Red peppers one half and green the other.
facts.applied_text: Their TV ad plays here. Half red, half green.

notes: Punch-Out Pizzeria, the wall TV commercial, Giuseppe on the Jump Man cabinet and Spike's slice confirmed on Super Mario Wiki. 'Ha! He got the Blue Mushroom!' (Donkey Kong) and 'Brooklyn's favorite failures' (Spike) verbatim on Wikiquote. Fire Peach, Rainbow Road, blue-shelled Koopa General, Ice Flower, manhole cover and Mini Mushroom on Wikipedia and Wikiquote.

vibe.verdict: Punch-Out Pizzeria is the right room and the Blue Mushroom line lands, but three dish notes are moment-only stubs with no food and the 'Now showing' box repeats the poster's title art.
